newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT- UPM-Kymmene cut to match.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- UPM-Kymmene cut to match.

text.p: Danish bank Den Danske Bank's equity research said in a report dated July 25 and received on Wednesday it had lowered its recommendation on Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy to match from outperform.
"The UPM-Kymmene stock has exceeded our target price of 130 markka ... hence we lower our rating from outperform to match," Den Danske said.
At 0900 GMT, UPM traded at 132.80 markka, up 0.30.

The bank said the share's upside potential was limited, adding UPM-Kymmene's expected profitability in 1997-2001 was "not very promising." More than 40 percent of 1997 profits would be capital gains from sales of assets, it said.
Den Danske forecast UPM-Kymmene's 1997 pre-tax profit to rise to 4.5 billion markka from 3.6 billion in 1996, but to fall to 3.8 billion in 1998. @
The bank's economic value added model indicated that UPM-Kymmene even in the expected peak year of 1999 (forecast pre-tax profit FIM 6.3 billion) would have trouble creating value for shareholders.
"The company's main problem in this respect is much too much capital employed," Den Danske said.
UPM-Kymmene should repay more debt to increase return on capital employed, it said.
